name: would-you-rather-questions
description: Would You Rather Questions – static Astro site on Cloudflare Workers with Supabase content.

scripts.build: npm run validate:content && astro build && npm run budget
scripts.build:mock: cross-env DATA_PROVIDER=mock ALLOW_MOCK_IN_PRODUCTION=true ALLOW_DEMO_CONTENT=true CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=1x00000000000000000000AA npm run validate:content && cross-env DATA_PROVIDER=mock ALLOW_MOCK_IN_PRODUCTION=true ALLOW_DEMO_CONTENT=true CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=1x00000000000000000000AA TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY=1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA VOTER_HASH_SECRET=mock-build-voter-secret-at-least-32-characters astro build --mode mock && npm run budget
